artifacts.summary: 6-phase implementation plan covering algebraic-Hilbert bridge, ND capture-avoidance fix, ProofSystem documentation and instances, abstract completeness extraction, and test coverage

memory_candidates.content: CSLib's Propositional/ module already has algebraic completeness (alg_complete) and Hilbert-ND equivalence (hilbert_iff_nd) as separate theorems, but lacks the composition bridging them. The bridge is a straightforward composition of these two existing results. This pattern of 'existing halves, missing bridge' recurs across CSLib logics and should be checked whenever a completeness result seems absent.
